description: Former Afghanistan fast bowler Shapoor Zadran died in India on Tuesday. He was 38 and had been battling a rare illness for months. His passing has prompted widespread tributes from the cricket community.

Virginia county manager: Electricity rates to rise sharply from July 1
description: As the tech landscape evolves with AI data centers, electricity costs are soaring. Henrico County, Virginia, has announced a staggering 25% hike in electricity bills for government facilities, prompting local officials to urge power conservation among their employees. Residents are also feeling the pinch, with some facing bill doubles. This phenomenon underscores the mounting pressure on community resources amid the rapid expansion of data centers.

title: 148 newborn die in 3 months in Assam's Barak Valley; infra gaps under scanner
description: Barak Valley recorded 148 newborn deaths over three months. Cachar district reported the highest fatalities, followed by Sribhumi and Hailakandi. Deaths were mainly due to birth asphyxia and low birth weight. Rural healthcare infrastructure and delayed referrals worsened the situation. Investment in rural maternal and child healthcare is urgently needed.

title: Blake Lively, Ryan Reynolds reportedly devastated over Swift-Kelce wedding snub
description: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce just had the wedding of the year as billions across the world cheered them on throughout the world across countries. While the wedding pictures have been kept strictly private, Blake Lively and Ryan Reynolds remained missing from the party. At a time when Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce publicly distanced themselves from the Hollywood power couple, it seems both Blake Lively and Ryan Reynolds are furious at this.
